import datetime
import math
import re
import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Common null placeholders
    null_exprs = [
        pl.col(c).str.strip_chars().str.to_lowercase().is_in(["", "n/a", "-", "null"])
        for c in raw.columns
    ]
    null_mask = pl.any_horizontal(null_exprs)

    # 1. device_id: String, uppercase
    device_id = pl.when(null_mask).then(None).otherwise(
        pl.col("Sensor ID").str.to_uppercase()
    ).alias("device_id")

    # 2. read_at: Datetime(time_unit='us', time_zone=None)
    read_at = pl.when(null_mask).then(None).otherwise(
        pl.col("Recorded At").str.to_datetime(
            format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", strict=False
        )
    ).cast(pl.Datetime("us")).alias("read_at")

    # 3. temperature_c: Float64 (Fahrenheit to Celsius: (F - 32) * 5/9)
    temp_f = pl.col("Temp (F)").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
    temp_c_val = (temp_f - 32.0) * (5.0 / 9.0)
    temperature_c = pl.when(null_mask).then(None).otherwise(
        temp_c_val.round(2)
    ).alias("temperature_c")

    # 4. humidity_pct: Float64
    humidity_pct = pl.when(null_mask).then(None).otherwise(
        pl.col("Humidity (%)").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2)
    ).alias("humidity_pct")

    # 5. battery_v: Float64
    battery_v = pl.when(null_mask).then(None).otherwise(
        pl.col("Battery (V)").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2)
    ).alias("battery_v")

    return raw.select([device_id, read_at, temperature_c, humidity_pct, battery_v])
